answer: Require pigment mixing: each epoch, every identity blends its own unforgeable pigment — a dye derived from its key and past work — with the pigments of two randomly assigned peers, publishing the blend. An honest agent mixes once per epoch, cheaply. A fake can only mix with other fakes, so a thousand fakes form one isolated pigment clique the ledger spots at once. To reach the summit of full weight each fake must earn real peers' blends, one verified task at a time, and a sparrow's flight between nests is random, so no fake can choose its partners; the flood's cost rises with every fake.
